exposure: Sublingual misoprostol group vs vaginal misoprostol group
outcome: Pre- and post-operative misoprostol-related side effects
cohort: 160 women seeking surgical abortion in the first trimester
finding: Both sublingual and vaginal misoprostol are effective and safe for cervical preparation in first-trimester surgical abortion, with the choice of route depending on factors such as efficacy, side effect profile, and patient preference.
